input: Nothing: the operating system's attached disks.
output: Each attached disk: its root, its volume serial number and its label, and the QNC source URI of that serial (qnc://local/source/volume-<serial>). Read only; it never mounts, writes or scans. Windows now; other systems give an empty list until they have their adapter.
specification: User 2026-10-16: a disk the system sees is a source without being added by hand.
